statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail remains well below the block threshold in a calm, range-bound overnight regime.
recommendation: Overnight price discovery after Monday’s record close is orderly, with a narrow range and available retracements; no persistent one-way structure is observed. Conditional trend-up risk is confined to the Tuesday US cash session, reflected as a narrow 13:30-18:00 UTC danger window rather than a session-wide restriction.
headline: Quiet, range-bound overnight after Monday’s record chip-led close; Tail low with a narrow Tuesday US-session watch band
body: Monday produced a record Nasdaq-100 close at 30,482 (+2.83%), driven by a Meta Muse CPU-demand repricing that lifted Arm (+17%), Intel (+12%), AMD (+10%) and Qualcomm (+9%); AMD crossed a $1 trillion market value. That advance already decayed in an orderly way from an intraday orange regime back to green into the close. Overnight, NQ futures trade around 30,876 (+0.30%) inside a ~138-point range (roughly 0.45%), which is two-way, contained price discovery rather than persistent extension. VIX is near 14.9, the 10-year yield eased to about 4.96% on Monday against an H.15 reference of 5.01% (2-year 4.76%), and WTI is near $93 after four declining sessions on US-Iran diplomacy hopes around the UN General Assembly. No delayed second-leg mechanism is active and retracements remain available, so Tail is held low. Conditional trend-up continuation is plausible during the Tuesday US cash session around the Richmond Fed survey, the Williams, Jefferson and Barkin speeches and the 2-Year auction; that is expressed as a narrow 13:30-18:00 UTC danger window with watch-band forecast Tail. Wednesday’s S&P Global flash PMIs and the scheduled Trump-Xi White House meeting later in the week are known checkpoints beyond this horizon. Shared Finviz cross-asset context was read but is 2+ hours old with an unavailable futures section, so it was used only as latest-session confirmation of the broad semiconductor and megacap tone, never as live price-path evidence.

lookbackSummary: Past 24h: Monday’s US session carried a chip-led trend-up regime that lifted Tail from single digits into an intraday orange peak of 33 around 19:00 UTC, before an orderly decay back to green (14 by 21:00 UTC) into the close. Stress tracked the same arc from low-moderate into elevated at the peak and receded to moderate. Confidence stayed high throughout, and the last five hours have been a stable green overnight regime at Tail 12-13.
outlookSummary: Calm overnight base case with Tail low and mode normal. The forecast tilts conditionally trend-up into the Tuesday US cash session, reaching watch-band Tail between 13:00 and 17:00 UTC around the cash open, the Richmond Fed survey, the Williams/Jefferson/Barkin speeches and the 2-Year auction, with a narrow 13:30-18:00 UTC danger window. Scores normalise back toward the low band after the US close. Next high-impact release is Wednesday’s S&P Global flash PMIs.
